titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Engineering (w/m/d)

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 3000 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
Im Operations beschaffen wir hochwertige Rohstoffe, produzieren frische Couverturen und veredeln sie in unserer Manufaktur zu FrischSchoggi, Pralinés, Truffes und Figuren. Unsere Supply-Chain-Teams bringen diese zuverlässig in die Stores und zu unseren Online-Kundinnen und -Kunden – unterstützt von Qualität, Engineering und Sustainability. Werde Teil unseres Teams!

Das erwartet dich

• Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für Engineering, Infrastruktur und Operational Excellence

• Du arbeitest nah am Betrieb und verbindest strategische Weitsicht mit operativer Umsetzung

• Du führst vier direkte sowie mehrere indirekte Mitarbeitende ganzheitlich in den Bereichen Technischer Dienst, Infrastruktur, Project Engineering und Continuous Improvement.

• Du berichtest direkt an den COO und agierst als strategischer und operativer Sparringspartner

• Du stellst eine stabile, sichere und skalierbare technische Basis an allen Produktions- und Logistikstandorten sicher

• Du entwickelst und implementierst eine Digitalisierungs- und Skalierungsstrategie zur Unterstützung von Qualität, Mitarbeitenden und Wachstum

• Du planst und realisierst Produktions- und Logistiklösungen inklusive Neubauten, Umbauten und Erweiterungen und stellst deren Betriebs- und Wartungstauglichkeit sicher

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast mindestens einen Hochschulabschluss (FH/Uni/ETH) in einem ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Fach wie Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Verfahrenstechnik; weiterführende Qualifikationen wie Lean Six Sigma, Projektmanagement-Zertifikate oder ein Masterabschluss sind von Vorteil

• Du verfügst über langjährige Führungserfahrung in industriellen Produktionsumfeldern, vorzugsweise in der Lebensmittelindustrie

• Du bringst ein tiefes Verständnis für Prozesse, Technik und Menschen mit

• Du hast nachweisliche Erfolge in Organisations- und Prozessentwicklung (CI, Lean, Digitalisierung) und Freude an operativer Führung über mehrere technische Fachbereiche hinweg

• Du bringst Erfahrung in CAPEX-Planung, technischen Standards und Lifecycle-Management mit und kannst komplexe technische Themen klar vermitteln

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ausgeprägte Stärke im Stakeholder-Management

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Kostenlose Parkplätze

• Vergünstigungen im Läderach Café und Personalrestaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Emilija Minova , Head Talent Acquistion/Employer Branding, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cioccolato fresco di alta qualità – ecco cosa rappresenta il produttore svizzero di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, l'azienda di famiglia oggi impiega più di 3000 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi in tutto il Gruppo, e la tendenza sta aumentando. La sede della società si trova nel Canton Glarus. Di fronte a un pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo i nostri cioccolatini freschi qui e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee innovative nelle squadre agili.
Nell'operazione, proviamo materie prime di alta qualità, produciamo couverture fresche e le affinamo nella nostra produzione a FrischSchoggi, Pralinés, Truffes e figure. I nostri team di supply chain li portano in modo affidabile ai negozi e ai nostri clienti online – supportati da qualità, ingegneria e sostenibilità. Diventa parte della nostra squadra!

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Hai una responsabilità complessiva per l'ingegneria, l'infrastruttura e l'eccellenza operativa

• Lavorate vicino all'azienda e combinate la previsione strategica con l'implementazione operativa

• Condurrai quattro dipendenti diretti e diversi indiretti in modo olistico nei settori del servizio tecnico, delle infrastrutture, dell'ingegneria del progetto e del miglioramento continuo.

• Si riferisce direttamente al COO e agire come partner strategico e operativo sparring

• Garantisci una base tecnica stabile, sicura e scalabile in tutte le sedi di produzione e logistica

• Sviluppi e implementa una strategia di digitalizzazione e scaling per supportare qualità, dipendenti e crescita

• Pianifica e realizza soluzioni produttive e logistiche tra cui nuovi edifici, conversioni e ampliamenti e garantisci la loro idoneità operativa e di manutenzione

Lo porti con te.

• Hai almeno una laurea (FH/uni/ETH) in un campo di ingegneria come ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica o ingegneria di processo; Ulteriori qualifiche come Lean Six Sigma, certificati di gestione del progetto o master sono vantaggiosi

• Hai molti anni di esperienza di leadership negli ambienti di produzione industriale, preferibilmente nell'industria alimentare

• Porti una profonda comprensione dei processi, della tecnologia e delle persone

• Hai dimostrato successo nello sviluppo organizzativo e di processo (CI, magra, digitalizzazione) e goditi la leadership operativa in più dipartimenti tecnici

• Hai esperienza nella pianificazione CAPEX, negli standard tecnici e nella gestione del ciclo di vita e puoi comunicare chiaramente argomenti tecnici complessi

• Hai una buona conoscenza della gestione degli stakeholder tedeschi e forti

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale

• L'opportunità di portare idee fresche

• Una cultura di feedback aperta e rispettosa

• Formazione interna ed esterna

• Opportunità di carriera individuali

• Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti

• Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro

• Parcheggio gratuito

• Sconti in Läderach Café e ristorante personale

Da solo. Crescete. Fallo fresco.

Sembra interessante? Allora applicaci. Emilija Minova, Head of Talent Acquistion/Employer Branding, è a vostra disposizione per qualsiasi domanda.
descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 3000 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
In the operation, we procure high-quality raw materials, produce fresh couvertures and refine them in our manufacture to FrischSchoggi, Pralinés, Truffes and figures. Our supply chain teams bring them reliably to the stores and to our online customers – supported by quality, engineering and sustainability. Become part of our team!

This is what awaits you

• You have overall responsibility for engineering, infrastructure and operational excellence

• You work close to the company and combine strategic foresight with operational implementation

• You will lead four direct and several indirect employees holistically in the areas of technical service, infrastructure, project engineering and continuous improvement.

• You report directly to the COO and act as a strategic and operational sparring partner

• You ensure a stable, secure and scalable technical basis at all production and logistics locations

• You develop and implement a digitalization and scaling strategy to support quality, employees and growth

• You plan and realize production and logistics solutions including new buildings, conversions and extensions and ensure their operational and maintenance suitability

You bring that with you

• You have at least one university degree (FH/uni/ETH) in an engineering subject such as mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or process engineering; Further qualifications such as Lean Six Sigma, project management certificates or a master’s degree are beneficial

• You have many years of leadership experience in industrial production environments, preferably in the food industry

• You bring a deep understanding of processes, technology and people

• You have proven success in organizational and process development (CI, lean, digitalization) and enjoy operational leadership across multiple technical departments

• You have experience in CAPEX planning, technical standards and lifecycle management and can clearly communicate complex technical topics

• You have very good knowledge of German and strong stakeholder management

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Emilija Minova, Head of Talent Acquistion/Employer Branding, is at your disposal for any questions.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chocolat frais de haute qualité – c'est ce que représente le fabricant suisse de chocolat Läderach. Fondée en 1962, l'entreprise familiale emploie aujourd'hui plus de 3000 personnes de plus de 80 pays dans l'ensemble du Groupe, et la tendance est à la hausse. Le siège de l'entreprise est situé dans le canton de Glarus. Devant un décor alpin pittoresque, nous produisons ici nos chocolats frais et développons constamment de nouvelles idées innovantes en équipe agile.
Dans l'opération, nous achetons des matières premières de haute qualité, produisons des couvertures fraîches et les affinons dans notre fabrication à FrischSchoggi, Pralinés, Truffes et figures. Nos équipes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement les apportent de manière fiable aux magasins et à nos clients en ligne, soutenus par la qualité, l'ingénierie et la durabilité. Faites partie de notre équipe !

C'est ce qui vous attend

• Vous avez la responsabilité globale de l'ingénierie, de l'infrastructure et de l'excellence opérationnelle

• Vous travaillez près de l'entreprise et combinez prospective stratégique et mise en œuvre opérationnelle

• Vous dirigerez quatre employés directs et plusieurs employés indirects dans les domaines du service technique, de l'infrastructure, de l'ingénierie de projet et de l'amélioration continue.

• Vous faites directement rapport au COO et agissez comme un partenaire stratégique et opérationnel

• Vous assurez une base technique stable, sécurisée et évolutive sur tous les sites de production et de logistique

• Vous développez et implémentez une stratégie de numérisation et d'échelle pour soutenir la qualité, les employés et la croissance

• Vous planifiez et réalisez des solutions de production et de logistique, y compris de nouveaux bâtiments, des conversions et des extensions et assurez leur fonctionnalité opérationnelle et de maintenance

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Vous avez au moins un diplôme universitaire (FH/uni/ETH) dans un domaine d'ingénierie comme le génie mécanique, le génie électrique ou le génie des procédés; D'autres qualifications telles que Lean Six Sigma, des certificats de gestion de projet ou un master sont bénéfiques

• Vous avez de nombreuses années d'expérience dans les environnements de production industrielle, de préférence dans l'industrie alimentaire

• Vous apportez une compréhension profonde des processus, de la technologie et des gens

• Vous avez prouvé votre succès dans le développement organisationnel et de processus (CI, maigre, numérisation) et profitez du leadership opérationnel dans plusieurs départements techniques

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans la planification CAPEX, les normes techniques et la gestion du cycle de vie et pouvez clairement communiquer des sujets techniques complexes

• Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et une gestion forte des parties prenantes

C'est ce que nous vous offrons.

• Un environnement de travail passionnant avec des collègues motivés

• Un poste avec beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles

• L'occasion d'apporter de nouvelles idées

• Une culture de rétroaction ouverte et respectueuse

• Formation interne et externe

• Possibilités de carrière individuelles

• Des rabais généreux sur nos produits

• Chocolat sur le lieu de travail

• Parking gratuit

• Réductions en Läderach Café et restaurant du personnel

Ça semble intéressant ? Alors appliquez-nous. Emilija Minova, responsable de la marque Talent Acquistion/Employer Branding, est à votre disposition pour toutes questions.

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 3000 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
In unserer Produktion stellen wir aus hochwertigen Rohstoffen frische Couverturen her. Anschliessend verarbeiten und veredeln wir die flüssigen Schokoladen in unserer Schokoladenmanufaktur zu FrischSchoggi, Pralinés, Truffes, Figuren und vielem mehr. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du betreust selbstständig spezielle Anlagen und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Instandhaltung im Bereich Mechanik und Mechatronik

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Leistungserbringung im Bereich Technischer Dienst, insbesondere für Reparaturen und Instandhaltungsarbeiten gemäss Auftrag und Zielvorgaben

• Du analysierst Störungen und Fehler und kümmerst dich um deren nachhaltige Behebung durch Umbauten oder Änderungen

• Du planst und führst Revisionen sowie Instandhaltungsarbeiten an den Anlagen durch

• Du stellst sicher, dass alle Anlagen, Maschinen, die Infrastruktur und die Gebäude in Ennenda und Bilten jederzeit funktionsfähig und verfügbar sind

• Du achtest auf die Einhaltung der Betriebssicherheit und hilfst aktiv bei deren Durchsetzung

Das bringst du mit

• Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung als Mechaniker in der Automobilbranche und hast dich im Bereich Mechatronik umfassend weitergebildet

• Du verfügst über handwerkliches Geschick und ein tiefgehendes technisches Verständnis für alle Anlagen, sowohl in Gebäuden als auch an Produktionsmaschinen

• Du hast Zusatzkenntnisse in Bereichen wie Pneumatik, Hydraulik, Elektrik und SPS-Steuerung

• Schweisserfahrung (idealerweise TIG und auch MIG/MAG) sowie Kenntnisse in mechanischen Fertigungstechniken wie Fräsen und Drehen sind von Vorteil

• Du bist körperlich belastbar und besitzt versierte PC-Kenntnisse

• Du bist bereit, im Pikettdienst zu arbeiten und besitzt einen Führerschein

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Kostenlose Parkplätze

• Vergünstigungen im Läderach Café und Personalrestaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Juan Marfil, Bereichsleiter Technischer Dienst, Tel. 055 645 77 71, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 3000 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
In our production, we produce fresh couvertures from high-quality raw materials. Afterwards, we process and refine the liquid chocolates in our chocolate factory to form FrischSchoggi, pralinés, truffes, figures and much more. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us.

This is what awaits you

• You independently supervise special facilities and assume responsibility for maintenance in the area of mechanics and mechatronics

• You are responsible for the provision of services in the area of technical service, in particular for repairs and maintenance work according to the order and objectives

• You analyze faults and errors and take care of their sustainable correction through modifications or changes

• You plan and carry out revisions and maintenance work on the plants

• Ensure that all facilities, machinery, infrastructure and buildings in Ennenda and Bilten are operational and available at all times

• You pay attention to compliance with operational safety and actively help to enforce it

You bring that with you

• You have in-depth experience as a mechanic in the automotive industry and have received comprehensive training in the field of mechatronics

• You have craftsmanship and an in-depth technical understanding of all equipment, both in buildings and on production machinery.

• You have additional knowledge in areas such as pneumatics, hydraulics, electrics and PLC control

• Welding experience (ideally TIG and also MIG/MAG) as well as knowledge of mechanical manufacturing techniques such as milling and turning are advantageous

• You are physically resilient and have experienced PC skills

• You are ready to work in the pikettdienst and have a driving license

This is what we offer you

• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas

• An open and respectful feedback culture

• Internal and external training

• Individual career opportunities

• Generous discounts on our products

• Chocolate in the workplace

• Free parking

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Juan Marfil, Head of Technical Service, tel. 055 645 77 71, is at your disposal for any questions.

We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Founded in 1962, the family-owned company employs more than 2,200 people from more than 80 countries, and is now increasingly active in the group. The company's headquarters is located in the canton of Glarus. In front of the picturesque alpine scenery, we produce our fresh chocolates and develop new creative ideas in the teams of the Alain. In addition to our Finance and IT-Services, we also have global marketing and sales management as well as human capital. Fresh ideas are created every day here, which we lead together to success. We care about our own responsibility and connected work. Do you want to participate in this? Then come to us. This is what awaits you - You are responsible for the entire end-to-end recruitment process for specialist, management and key positions mainly in retail - You control the recruitment process in close cooperation with HR Business partners and the executives – from demand analysis to contract signing - You define requirements profiles, selection criteria and matching recruiting channels together with the Hiring managers - You conduct interviews independently and accompany the selection process until the final decision - You build sustainable talent pipelines for Follow-up appointments and use Active Sourcing and Direct Search, especially via LinkedIn - You act as sparring partner:in for executives and HR Business Partner in all questions about recruiting strategies and personnel acquisition - You proactively drive Active Sourcing and identify suitable talents primarily for retail positions in the global environment - You support in the further development of social media activities as well as with Employer Branding Initiatives - You create a consistent and positive candidate experience across the entire recruiting process You have at least 3 years of experience in end-to-end recruiting (ideally in-house) for specialist and management positions - you have a sound recruiting expertise in retail and know the specific requirements of operational and central retail functions; international experience is beneficial - you have proven experience in active sourcing, especially via LinkedIn Recruiter, with - you convince through strong stakeholder management in dealing with Hiring Managers and HR Business Partners - you have a strong knowledge of Communication and consulting skills - You work structured, driven by a high level of affinity to modern recruiting methods - You have experience in building and maintaining talent pipelines and in designing a positive candidate experience - You are professional and confident in international and dynamic corporate structures - You have very good German, French and English skills in word and writing This is what we offer you - An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues - A position with lots of Self-responsibility - The possibility to bring fresh ideas - An open and respectful feedback culture - Internal and external training - Individual career opportunities - Generous discounts on our products - Chocolate at the workplace - Free parking - Discounts at Läderach Café and staff restaurant Own it. 93 it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Emilija Minova, Head TalentSriving & Employer Branding is at your disposal for questions. We would like to ask you to understand that we do not take external personnel agencies into account when filling this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams. Various activities are bundled in our Corporate Functions division. In addition to our finance and IT services, this area also includes global marketing and sales management as well as human resources. Every day fresh ideas are created here, which together we lead to success. Personal responsibility and networked work are particularly important to us. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us. This is what awaits you
• You’ll be responsible for the entire product lifecycle of your seasonal product line, from concept to market launch, ensuring everything aligns with market demands and profitability goals.
• You develop and realize innovations and renovations in line with the strategy and customer needs in close collaboration with cross-functional teams
• Analyze market trends and consumer feedback to continuously improve the portfolio
• You are responsible for the market launch strategy for new products and coordinate a smooth exit of the market during delistings
• You drive continuous improvement by identifying and successfully implementing potential for increasing efficiency in product development, packaging and market launch strategy You bring that with you
• You have a bachelor’s degree in economics, marketing or a related field
• You bring 3 to 5 years of proven success in the holistic management of products in the FMCG, food or chocolate industry
• You understand how to translate product requirements into clear briefings for different stakeholders
• You have strong analytical skills and experience in profitability analysis and the evaluation of market data
• You speak fluent German and have a good knowledge of English This is what we offer you
• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility and internal visibility
• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Hybrid work (Bilten, Zurich, home office)
• Lots of chocolate in the workplace

• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant Contact details Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Fabio Ferramosca, Talent Acquisition Partner is at your disposal for any questions. We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.

Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du berätst kundenorientiert und verkaufst unser vielfältiges Warensortiment, zum
Beispiel bei der Geschenkauswahl

• Du kümmerst dich um die Kassiervorgänge und sorgst für eine präzise und korrekte Abrechnung

• Du präsentierst das erlesene Confiserie- und Schokoladensortiment auf eine geschmackvolle einladende Weise

• Du setzt unsere hohen Qualitätsstandards mit Hingabe und Sorgfalt um

• Du achtest auf die Einhaltung des Hygiene- und Frischekonzepts

Das bringst du mit
Du bringst wertvolle Berufserfahrung im Detailhandel mit und hast eine echte Leidenschaft für den Verkauf.
Du liebst es, unseren Kundinnen und Kunden eine besondere Freude zu bereiten und ihnen ein einzigartiges Einkaufserlebnis zu bieten.
Du stellst auch in turbulenten Zeiten höchste Qualität und Kundenorientierung stets an erste Stelle und überzeugst durch ein ausgeprägtes Bewusstsein für Details sowie für Premium-Produkte und -Services.
Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, bist ein echter Teamplayer und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Du fühlst dich in einem lebhaften Umfeld wohl und packst auch bei körperlich anspruchsvollen Tätigkeiten tatkräftig mit an.
Du schätzt eine offene und respektvolle Kommunikation und beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sicher; Kenntnisse in Französisch und weiteren Sprachen sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil.
Du bist flexibel einsetzbar und schätzt ein Arbeitsumfeld mit wechselnden Einsatztagen – unser Betrieb ist sieben Tage pro Woche von 09.00 bis 18.00 Uhr geöffnet und umfasst mindestens vier Wochenendeinsätze pro Monat.
Du hast keine Scheu vor Einsätzen an Wochenenden und Feiertagen – an 364 Tagen im Jahr sind wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden da.

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that’s what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are in the canton of Glarus. We produce our fresh chocolates here against a picturesque Alpine backdrop and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams. The “Retail” division includes over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Now we are writing a new chapter: With the opening of our first outlet in Switzerland, we are creating another place where chocolate lovers can discover the world of Läderach. Do you also want to take part? Then come to us. This is what awaits you
• You support the branch management in the daily management and organization of the branch
• You offer competent, customer-oriented advice and support in the selection of gifts from our diverse range of goods
• You ensure the attractive presentation of our extensive confectionery and chocolate range, including through creative store design
• You guarantee top quality and consistently implement our high standards
• You are an important contact person for the team and for the customers
• You contribute to the Optimize work processes and ensure that the branch works efficiently and profitably What you bring with you
• You have completed training in retail and/or have comparable experience in dealing with food
• You have initial management experience in fashion retail, preferably in larger teams
• You have already worked with chocolate
• You love a hands-on mentality and are technically savvy
• You are keen to optimize and have an entrepreneurial mindset
• You have an extraordinary Quality and hygiene awareness
• You value open and respectful communication and have a confident command of German and English; Knowledge of French and other languages is an additional advantage
• You are not afraid of flexible working hours and are also fully involved on weekends, Saturdays, Sundays or public holidays This is what we offer you
• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility
• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Chocolate at work
• Easy access to the locations Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Franziska Franz, Regional Sales Manager, +41 79 521 61 88, will be happy to answer any questions you may have. We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

La divisione “Retail” comprende più di 250 cioccolatini in più di 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a sperimentare il cioccolato fresco ancora e ancora. • Sei motivato a sviluppare in vendite e servizi Sei flessibile e non hai paura di incarichi nei fine settimana, sabato, domenica o festivi E' questo che ti offriamo. Un ambiente di lavoro emozionante con colleghi motivati

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that’s what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are in the canton of Glarus. We produce our fresh chocolates here against a picturesque Alpine backdrop and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams. The “Retail” division includes over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to take part? Then come to us. This is what awaits you
• You provide customer-oriented advice and sell our diverse range of goods, for example when choosing gifts
• You actively respond to our customers, recognize their needs and offer suitable solutions
• You take care of the checkout processes and ensure precise and correct billing
• You present the exquisite confectionery and chocolate range in a tasteful and inviting way
• You also take on production activities as well as that Stocking and maintaining the sales areas
• You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care
• You consistently ensure compliance with the hygiene and freshness concept
• You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working atmosphere
• Depending on the branch, there is the opportunity to get involved in vocational training and accompany apprentices This is what you bring with you
• You bring valuable professional experience in the retail trade and have a passion for sales as well as a strong focus on completion
• You love working with customers to be in direct contact and offer them a special shopping experience
• You recognize needs quickly and provide individual, friendly and convincing advice
• You have very good communication skills and express yourself clearly and confidently
• You speak German and English very well; French and other languages are a big advantage and are particularly valued
• You put quality and customer orientation first, even in turbulent times
• You work responsibly, reliably and in a structured manner
• You have a high level of quality awareness and consistently adhere to hygiene and cleanliness standards
• You like to take on responsibility, are a real team player and are committed to common goals
• You are motivated to develop further in sales and service
• You are flexible and are not afraid of working on weekends, Saturdays and Sundays or holidays This is what we offer you
• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility
• The opportunity to contribute fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external further training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Chocolate at work
• Easy access to the locations Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Michael Notter, branch manager, +41 41 44 210 11 59 will be happy to answer any questions you may have. We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Täglich entstehen hier frische Ideen, die wir gemeinsam zum Erfolg führen. Eigenverantwortung und vernetztes Arbeiten sind uns besonders wichtig. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du führst das IT Retail Support Team (3 Supporter & 1 Technical Product Owner) fachlich und personell und entwickelst ein leistungsstarkes, international ausgerichtetes Team mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Du stellst einen effizienten, skalierbaren sowie serviceorientierten 1st- und 2nd-Level Support für über 150 Filialen sicher und entwickelst die Eigenlösungskompetenz im 2nd Level kontinuierlich weiter

• Du verantwortest die Personal- und Einsatzplanung inkl. Pikett-Dienst (inkl. eigener Teilnahme)

• Du etablierst und optimierst Support-Standards, KPIs und Prozesse (z. B. Incident, Problem und Knowledge Management) zur Sicherstellung von Operational Excellence

• Du übernimmst die IT-seitige Gesamtverantwortung für Filialeröffnungen und Umbauten in Europa und koordinierst interne wie externe Stakeholder
